scope: First complete independent Git/Shell/Linux exact movie review.

lessons.reason: Concrete snapshots, real JSONL bytes, actual exact integer gates, Bash statuses, process identity, device mapping and fresh ownership contrast teach the mechanism well. A bounded legacy fixed-result staging group and four uninspectably short same-beat predictions remain. Preserve honest current constructions and already-earned repeats. Secondary reference panels, long holds and authoring-oriented compact byte labels retain deductions.

blockers.detail: GS-ENC-01: Nine fixed-result probes appear before their completed clauses: new four-row failed inequality265.625667s; array failure288.5375s and remaining invalid-input failures294.1375s; c3/c5/c4 tested verdicts436.6375/443.6565/446.9315s; grep status1/status2 at485.955333/491.505333s; and newly empty clone git status1001.104s. The score row counters, prior known equality/four-row result and actual current construction are excluded.

GS-ENC-02: Four actual questions and answers remain in uninterrupted provider audio: plain-commit prediction gap.4125s, newline-count prediction gap.4125s, fresh5/7 gate gap.475s and fresh clone gap.4125s. Each authored hold follows the answer, so it does not provide a usable inspection interval before the solution.
